Subject: Billing sender and portal preference for Redwood pilot

Hi Markus / Connor,

We're kicking off the pilot (PO GF-7391) next month — quick AP question to make sure our systems map cleanly: who will be the invoice originator for Redwood invoices (vendor email or portal originator field)? Horizon's AP matching requires either a consistent vendor email on the invoice or the portal-originator tag that our connector uses.

Also important for our tax team: please confirm whether Redwood will include our EU VAT ID on the invoice and whether you expect reverse-charge to apply.

Two preferences from our side (please confirm feasibility):
- Push to our portal via webhook/API with a nightly PDF copy to accounts-payable@horizon-tech.com
- Or email PDF(s) from a single vendor sender address (we can only whitelist one)

Can you also send a sample invoice and a short onboarding checklist for the portal option? If we can lock this down this week we can meet the internal cutover calendar.

Thanks,
Marie Clarke
Senior Procurement Manager, Horizon Tech
marie.clarke@horizon-tech.com

Attachment: horizon_ap_spec.pdf (AP spec, mapping fields)

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14 13:45 +01:00
Subject: Re: Billing sender and portal preference for Redwood pilot

Hi Marie — thanks for the clear note and the PO reference. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

Short answers:
- Invoice originator: We can set the invoice "From" address to a single vendor mailbox (redwood-invoices@redwood.com) AND we can populate a portal-originator field for webhook deliveries. Both are supported; choice depends on your AP matching preference.
- VAT / reverse-charge: We will populate the invoice with the buyer VAT ID in the VAT section if you provide it. For EU reverse-charge we typically include the buyer VAT and a reverse-charge line item per local rules; confirm your tax team's desired wording and we will mirror it.

Tradeoffs:
- Portal webhook + nightly PDF copy: best for structured ingestion (AP auto-posting) and audit trail. Slightly longer onboarding (1–2 weeks) to wire the connector and map fields.
- Single-sender email PDF: fastest to start (1–3 business days) but requires you to whitelist redwood-invoices@redwood.com and you lose field-level structure (more manual matching).

I've attached: redwood_sample_invoice_v2.xlsx (example invoice), portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf (high-level steps).

Can you confirm which delivery you prefer? If portal, we'll need:
1) Technical contact for the webhook (URL and contact)
2) Confirm the invoice recipient address to receive nightly PDFs (accounts-payable@horizon-tech.com?)
3) Your buyer VAT ID for the invoice header

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute handoff with our billing engineer to close the mapping quickly.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Finance Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
